name: Donkey Calf Raise
steps: Stand facing a wall and hinge forward with your hands braced against it and your feet parallel.
Keep your knees nearly straight as you press through your forefeet to lift both heels.
Lower your heels quietly to the floor.
tips: Keep your hips still so the motion comes from your ankles.
Pause briefly at the top and lower your heels with control rather than bouncing.
